d: Watch as Firstpost examines Niger’s bold geopolitical strategy, as Niamey officially expands its diplomatic and security reach by engaging both rival power centres in a divided Libya. Niger’s Prime Minister has travelled to Benghazi to meet Saddam Haftar, deputy commander of eastern Libyan forces, signing a strategic cooperation protocol just months after agreeing to a military pact with Tripoli’s UN-recognised government. As the country secures its volatile 340-kilometre northern borderlands, tackles trafficking networks, and coordinates with incoming Algerian troops and Sahel alliance…
